subject: Marketplace evidence pack — renewal gating items & finance signoff
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@aws-partner.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Marketplace renewal — evidence package request and next steps

Hi Rachel,

Following up on ACME's upcoming renewal window for their AWS Marketplace listing (effective 11/01). Partner Ops needs a consolidated evidence package to validate continued listing incentives and any fee credits tied to their partner tier. At a minimum they asked for: 

- Signed 2024/2025 listing agreement (PDF)
- Proof of deployment (account IDs / metering report)
- Marketing co-sell assets referenced in the program approval
- Any previous Marketplace rebate/credit memos between Redwood and ACME

Can you confirm who on your side will assemble the evidence pack and a target delivery date? Partner Ops indicated they require materials by 09/24 to avoid a hold on the listing incentives. I attached the Partner Ops checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Liam

[Attachment: partner-ops-checklist.pdf]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Marketplace renewal — evidence package request and next steps

Hi Liam,

Thanks — looping in Vanessa (Partner Programs) and David (Finance/Procurement). We'll own the evidence pack but need to confirm a couple items internally before sending a consolidated ZIP. Quick notes: 

- Vanessa: can you pull the co-sell asset links and the historical rebate memos?
- Neha: can you confirm whether the deployment proof needs to include hourly metering logs or just the account subscription receipts? Partner Ops wasn't explicit.
- David: Procurement will need the signed agreement + any redlines we sent back in 2024; if there are open legal marks we need to push DocuSign.

Target: we'll aim to provide a draft package by 09/23 and the final by 09/24. If anything blocks that timeline I'll flag immediately.

Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Director, Strategic GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Marketplace renewal — evidence package request and next steps

Thanks, team. Quick update from Partner Programs side: I've collected the marketing co-sell assets and two memos from the 2024 incentive distribution. Attachments include the memos and a small README of where each asset should be placed in the final package.

Per Partner Ops: metering logs are helpful but not mandatory if we can supply the consolidated usage report + account subscription receipts. Neha, if you can export the consolidated usage CSV and share to the Drive folder Rachel mentioned, that'll satisfy the Ops ask.

I'm attaching the agreement we have on file (AWS_Marketplace_Agreement_v2.pdf) and a Word doc with a few proposed edits to the SOW section (redlines_marked.docx). If legal needs to re-sign, we should create an updated DocuSign envelope rather than mass-editing the PDF.

Vanessa

[Attachment: AWS_Marketplace_Agreement_v2.pdf]
[Attachment: redlines_marked.docx]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Marketplace renewal — evidence package request and next steps

Appreciate the heads up. Two procurement items before we ship: 

1) We need the final signed version of the agreement in DocuSign (with the negotiated SOW attached). If Vanessa/Legal mark changes, please send the DocuSign draft to procurement@redwood.com for final review.

2) Cost/credit tracking: Partner Ops asked for a reconciliation of listing fee credits applied in 2025 — can someone confirm total credits applied ($) vs. invoices? That's required to clear the renewal hold. 

If we can't produce the invoice reconciliation by 09/24, request an interim extension from Partner Ops (Liam) — ideally 48 hours. I can sign off on the DocuSign envelope once procurement confirms the invoice numbers.

David

Finance & Procurement
Redwood Inference

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@aws-partner.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Partner Ops <partner-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Marketplace renewal — evidence package request and next steps

Thanks all — confirming I've received the draft package link. Two quick items: 

- DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/templates/9a8f7e2a-aws-marketplace-sign (please send to procurement@redwood.com when ready)
- Partner Ops will accept a short invoice reconciliation spreadsheet as an interim deliverable; they can grant a 48-hour extension once it's filed in the Drive folder you shared.

I'll mark the renewal as "pending evidence" rather than placed on hold to give you the window. Please reply to this thread once procurement uploads the invoice reconciliation and you've sent the DocuSign envelope for signature.

Best,
Liam

[Attachment: partner-ops-confirmation.txt]
